definitions.explanation: A musical instrument played by pressing keys on a keyboard, such as the piano, organ, harpsichord, or synthesizer.

examples.english: The piano is the quintessential keyboard instrument.

notes:
{鍵盤楽器|けんばんがっき} is a compound of ⟦{鍵盤|けんばん}→鍵盤：14747_kenban⟧ (keyboard) and ⟦{楽器|がっき}→楽器：13159_gakki⟧ (musical instrument). The three main categories of Western instruments in Japanese are ⟦{弦楽器|げんがっき}→弦楽器：07534_gengakki⟧ (string instruments), ⟦{管楽器|かんがっき}→管楽器：07533_kangakki⟧ (wind instruments), and ⟦{打楽器|だがっき}→打楽器：07532_dagakki⟧ (percussion instruments). {鍵盤楽器|けんばんがっき} is sometimes treated as a subcategory of percussion or as its own group.
